question: Can an entity-specific official performance determination become the numeric input to a fixed statutory penalty formula without any mutation of that formula?

governing_rule.trigger: manufacturer average specific emissions of CO2 exceed the specific emissions target
governing_rule.formula: (excess emissions × EUR 95) × number of newly registered vehicles

metrics.metric_name: number of newly registered passenger cars

rule_evaluation.official_context: Decision (EU) 2024/865 recital 10 states that one passenger-car manufacturer has a positive distance to target and an excess emissions premium is therefore to be imposed.

shared_shape: source metric and rule evaluation remain independently auditable

differences.tnac: system-wide annual computed indicator published by Commission Communication
differences.vehicle_co2: entity-specific manufacturer performance values published by Commission Implementing Decision

architecture_probe.reason_for_separation: The same official metric observation may be evaluated under a later amended rule, and the same fixed rule may produce different outputs from future observations.

forbidden_inferences: Regulation (EU) 2019/631 Article 8 was amended by Decision (EU) 2024/865.
Bugatti's performance values are set-membership states.
The derived EUR 341046.96 figure is directly printed in Decision (EU) 2024/865.
A positive individual manufacturer distance to target implies a premium where compliance is assessed only at pool level.
Metric observation and rule evaluation should be collapsed into one mutable fact.

official_sources.locator: Annex I Table 1, BUGATTI AUTOMOBILES SAS
